working_memory.name: Working Memory Capacity
working_memory.definition: Ability to temporarily maintain, manipulate, and update transient information during ongoing cognitive processing.
working_memory.biases: Strategy formulation and chunking in early sessions; rehearsal effects.

selective_attention.name: Selective Attention & Interference Control
selective_attention.definition: Capacity to focus on goal-relevant stimuli while suppressing competitive, task-irrelevant perceptual distractors.
selective_attention.biases: Difference scores exhibit test-retest attenuation; automaticity decreases with practice.

cognitive_flexibility.name: Cognitive Flexibility & Set-Shifting
cognitive_flexibility.definition: Efficiency in alternating between multiple mental task rules or perspectives in response to changing contextual cues.
cognitive_flexibility.biases: Slower responders artificially show smaller relative switch costs; baseline RT confounding.

processing_speed.name: Perceptual Processing Speed
processing_speed.definition: The rate of executing elementary cognitive operations without requiring complex reasoning.
processing_speed.biases: Peripheral hardware/touchscreen input latency; speed-accuracy trade-off strategies.

inductive_reasoning.name: Inductive & Fluid Reasoning
inductive_reasoning.definition: Capacity to extrapolate latent rules, identify abstract geometric regularities, and infer missing relational patterns.
inductive_reasoning.biases: Item familiarity upon re-exposure; small item pool per session.
